evidence: Read instruction.md (5 lines) and all six notes in full. Spelling: no misspelling found by full read; British spelling is used consistently ('behaviour', 'Colour', 'coloured'); a grep for US variants (color, behavior, center, gray, -ize/-yze) across instruction.md and environment/instructions returned nothing, so there is no mixed-dialect drift. Product names are spelled correctly (ui.md:3 'CodeMirror, Monaco, Ace, ProseMirror, TipTap, Quill, Slate, Draft.js'). Contamination: the skill's grep 'CHANGE[_-]?ME|TODO|FIXME|XXX|<placeholder>|lorem ipsum' over instruction.md and environment/ returned nothing (the template's 'CHANGE_ME' placeholders in instruction.md and notes.md are gone, and no notes.md remains); no Windows drive paths, /home, /Users or localhost strings; no non-ASCII or control bytes; no doubled words; no duplicated paragraphs. Internal consistency checked: instruction.md:3 'the six notes in /instructions' matches exactly six files copied by Dockerfile 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/'; one seed path only ('/assets/seed_data.json' in instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7) and its description 'contains no user snippets or starter implementation' matches the seed ('"snippets": []') and instruction.md 'there is no starter app to finish'; no accounts anywhere (instruction.md:5 'without signing in', overview.md:3 'without accounts', policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts'); one run budget ('five-second run budget', behaviour.md:5) which is a different quantity from the library refresh 'within about five seconds' (behaviour.md:11); one port/entry/health statement (integration.md:3) and one DB path rule (integration.md:9). Candidate contradictions examined and rejected: (a) behaviour.md:3 'Nothing from an earlier run ... carries into the next one' versus behaviour.md:5 'restore that picture' - the second governs what is displayed after a failed run, the first governs what a new run starts from, and line 5 itself says 'A restored picture may be static'; (b) policy.md:3 'You may choose the ... routes' versus integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health' - integration.md states the two fixed paths first and then 'You may choose your routes', so the reading is unambiguous; (c) integration.md:3 'We start it with node /app/server.js' versus integration.md:9 'including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app' - test.sh lines 97-101 do use /app/server.js and fall back to a copy only when /app is not writable, and the note tells the builder 'Resolve files from their actual location', so both statements are true together; (d) ui.md:3 forbids an input 'as the document surface' while allowing 'A small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing' - a stated exception, not a conflict; (e) ui.md:9 single-caret typing 'in one step or character by character' versus 'A continuous multi-caret typing burst is one Undo action' - different cases. Non-blocking observation: policy.md:5 'Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract. The examples are ways to explain it, not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements.' reads slightly like author vocabulary ('public behaviour', 'selectors'), and the notes contain almost no examples for 'The examples' to refer to; it is a deliberate instruction to the builder, not a pasted author note, and contradicts nothing, so it does not fail this row (its grader-flavour, if any, belongs to row 5). Weak-app/alternative test for this row: no instruction wording was found that would lead a conforming builder to two incompatible products. This row is a static text property; no runtime evidence is required for it.
